action.description: [PROJECT] Deploy the last version on Kubernetes
[FEATURE] Display on logs the number of Blueprints downloaded.
[STORY] Activate the cache of Mining Operations on Redis as done with Blueprints.
[FEATURE] Display on logs the number of Extended Blueprints processed successfully.
[POC] Create a new NestJS project to test the ESI refresh token flow.
[REFACTOR] Add new exceptions for the ESI request processing.
[REFACTOR] Catch any exception on the JWT filter so any problem on that code will not block other filters and display useful exception reporting.
[CONFIG] Create a production like local configuration to test the production frontend against a development debugged backend.
[PROJECT] Create a new application and use a new account to check the refesh token.
[REFACTOR] Control request/response logs with application properties.
[BUG] The endpoint 'validateAuthenticationState' should not be authorized with JWT token.
[FEATURE] Add a unique default identifier for non request logs to keep log structure consistency.
[REFACTOR] LogMDCFilter is deprecated since we no longer need to record Heroku identifiers.
[SUPPORT] Add logs to the authorization NIB process so the Headers and Cookies are logged if the top level debug is active.
[FEATURE] Add a unique request identifier to logs to get trazability for requests.
[FEATURE] Authorization no longer relays on Cookies. So change the code to perform JWT validations only on accepted Headers.
[RESEARCH] How to collect Kubernetes pod logs to a central service, preferably Grafana.
[REFACTOR] Move the callback URL at NIF from environment configuration to deployment generation from the selected port.
[BUG] The callback URL for deployment is wrong and points to the PORT environment value.
[REFACTOR] .env.version file on NIN project is obsolete and not required for deployment. Remove from repository.
[BUG] The environment template with the environmwent values should be used during the deployment process to create the deployment configuration.
[STORY] Collect namespace logs into a single place.
[FEATURE] Create a Angular configuration service to read environment variables into configuration properties so ESI configuration can be externalized.
[REFACTOR] Remove the NEOCOM database string configuration environment variable.
[FEATURE] Adjust job scheduling to fire with half the time of refresh of the expected data from ESI endpoint. No point in calling ESI more times than required.
[CONFIG] Move scheduler configuration to an externally configured properties file to be setup as a ConfigMap.
[BUG] The token expiration with the trojan library does not refresh the access token. There is the urgent need to fix the ESI Authorization flow.
[FIX] The new ESI Http Client requires a different flow and new data structures.
[FEATURE] Add logs for the request and the response to NIB.\n[DONE] This is aready on place but if the JWT filter fails the code is not used so there are no logs.
[BUG] com.auth0.jwt.exceptions.JWTDecodeException: The token was expected to have 3 parts, but got 0.
[REFACTOR] Refactor and clean up the new OAuth implementation. Mark as Deprecated any unused code.
[FEATURE] A click on a Extended Blueprint should extend the data presented on the display as done at https://indeve.space/.
[STORY] Process Credential invalidation exceptions to disable the affected Credential.
[FEATURE] Validate Credential on each authenticated request. If the Credential has expired then return a 401 Unauthorized.
[FEATURE] If a backend call fails then mark the corresponding Credential as invalid.
[STORY] Change the Job system to disable jobs that are affected by expired Credentials.
[STORY] Use the visual presentation of https://indeve.space/ to render the Extended Blueprint.
[REFACTOR] Move OAuth code to a new module.
[STORY] Change the NIB requests to validate the state of the Credential. If the credential is not valid because the access token has expired then redirect back to the login to get a new token.
[REFACTOR] The job unique identifier should not be a number but a string so the credential can be added to the hash generated or be used directly.
[REFERENCE] https://indeve.space/ - Portal to display economic blueprint productivity.
